meps.description: Members of the European Parliament: name, group, country, committees, contacts

calendar.description: Parliament calendar: plenary, committee and group weeks

council.description: Council of the EU: configurations, meetings, presidency rotation, voting weights

sources.description: Source list: media outlets by tier, institutions and analysis sources nodo may cite, with excluded domains

searchTerms.description: Search terms: hand-kept nicknames of files (pointing at procedures) and topic words
